images.description: A plain light-coloured ball on a plain table, lit by ONE lamp from the LEFT.
images.shotNotes: Dark room. One lamp/torch on the left at about 45° height. Camera in front, at table level. The shadow must fall clearly to the right. No other lights.

images.description: The same ball lit from DIRECTLY ABOVE.
images.shotNotes: Dark room, one lamp straight above the ball. The shadow should be a small dark pool directly under the ball. Same camera position as img-light-ball-left.

images.description: A plain cardboard box (roughly a cube) lit from the RIGHT-FRONT.
images.shotNotes: Single lamp at front-right, slightly above. Camera at front-left so two faces of the box show. The top is brightest, the right face mid-tone and the left face darkest. The cast shadow falls back-left.

images.description: A steel tumbler BACKLIT: the lamp is behind it, facing the camera.
images.shotNotes: Lamp behind the tumbler, low, so the shadow stretches TOWARDS the camera. The tumbler's rim glows and its front is dark. Keep the lamp itself just out of frame.

images.description: An egg on a table lit from a LOW angle on the left, casting a very LONG shadow.
images.shotNotes: Lamp almost at table height, on the left. The shadow should be at least 4× as long as the egg. Camera slightly above, in front.

images.description: A bottle lit by TWO lamps, one on the left and one on the right, giving TWO shadows.
images.shotNotes: Two similar lamps at equal height on opposite sides. Two clear shadows should fan out behind the bottle. No other light.

images.description: Pressure cooker (lid on, with whistle) — FRONT view.
images.shotNotes: Camera at the cooker's mid-height, straight on, handle pointing towards the camera's right. Plain background. Phone held level, no tilt.

images.description: Same pressure cooker — TOP view (camera directly above).
images.shotNotes: Phone directly above, parallel to the table, so the lid shows as a circle with the whistle in the middle and handles sticking out.

images.description: Same pressure cooker — SIDE view, looking along the handle.
images.shotNotes: Camera at mid-height, with the handle pointing straight at the camera so the handles overlap. Plain background.

images.description: A pair of scissors lying flat, seen from directly above, blades slightly open.
images.shotNotes: Top view on a plain sheet of paper. The two handle loops should be visibly DIFFERENT sizes (most scissors have one small and one large loop).

images.description: An open umbrella seen from directly above.
images.shotNotes: Umbrella opened on the floor, camera directly above. All the ribs and panels should be visible as a radial pattern.

images.description: A plastic monobloc chair in a three-quarter view.
images.shotNotes: Camera at standing eye level, about 45° from the front. The whole chair is in frame. Several chairs stacked nearby is a bonus but not required.

images.description: A bicycle in exact side view.
images.shotNotes: Camera level with the hub height, perpendicular to the cycle, so both wheels look like circles (not ellipses).

images.description: A straight road, corridor or railway line running directly away from the camera (one-point perspective).
images.shotNotes: Stand in the middle, facing straight down it. The edges should meet at one point near the centre of the frame. Phone held level.

images.description: The corner of a building seen from street level, with two walls going away to the left and right (two-point perspective).
images.shotNotes: Face the corner of a house or building. Phone held upright (vertical lines stay vertical). The horizon is at your eye level.

images.description: A tall building or water tank photographed from close by, looking UP (three-point perspective).
images.shotNotes: Stand near the base and tilt the phone upwards so the vertical edges visibly converge towards the top.

images.description: Close-up of a woven cane chair seat or cane basket.
images.shotNotes: Fill the frame with the weave pattern. Soft daylight from a window. In focus.

images.description: Close-up of an unglazed terracotta pot (matka) surface.
images.shotNotes: Fill the frame with the reddish-brown, slightly porous surface. Daylight.

images.description: Close-up of polished granite (kitchen platform or step).
images.shotNotes: Speckled crystals clearly visible. Avoid glare by shooting at a slight angle.

images.description: Close-up of a jute (gunny) sack.
images.shotNotes: Coarse, loose weave clearly visible. Daylight.

images.description: Close-up of a polished brass lamp or pot.
images.shotNotes: Golden-yellow metallic surface with visible reflections. Avoid your own reflection.

images.description: A bamboo pole or bamboo basket showing nodes.
images.shotNotes: At least two nodes (the ring-like joints) clearly visible.

images.description: Close-up of natural wood grain (door, table top, plank).
images.shotNotes: Unpainted or clear-varnished wood with visible grain lines filling the frame.

images.description: Close-up of a coir doormat or coir rope.
images.shotNotes: Brown, bristly coconut fibre texture filling the frame.

images.description: Channapatna lacquered wooden toys (2–4 pieces).
images.shotNotes: Bright, glossy, rounded wooden toys on a plain background. Daylight. If you don't have any, use an open-licence photo instead.

images.description: A Bidriware object: black metal with silver inlay patterns.
images.shotNotes: Close enough that the silver inlay against the matte black body is clear.

images.description: An Ilkal saree showing the pallu and the border.
images.shotNotes: Spread the saree so the pallu (end piece) and part of the body show together. Daylight, no flash.

images.description: A Kinnal craft painted wooden figure or toy.
images.shotNotes: One figure, full height, plain background.

images.description: Kasuti embroidery close-up (often on an Ilkal saree or blouse piece).
images.shotNotes: Fill the frame with the small, geometric, counted-thread stitches.

images.description: A Warli painting showing stick figures (ideally a circular dance).
images.shotNotes: A print, wall painting or souvenir is fine. White figures on a brown/red base.

images.description: A Madhubani painting.
images.shotNotes: Whole painting in frame: dense patterns, double outlines, filled backgrounds.

images.description: A Dhokra metal figure (horse, elephant or tribal figure).
images.shotNotes: Plain background so the thread-like surface detail shows.

images.description: A piece of Jaipur blue pottery.
images.shotNotes: Cobalt-blue and turquoise floral patterns on a white base, clearly visible.

images.description: A piece of Kalamkari fabric.
images.shotNotes: Earthy natural-dye colours (rust, indigo, black, mustard) with figurative or floral motifs.

images.description: A standard Indian 'No Parking' road sign.
images.shotNotes: Red circle with a diagonal bar over a 'P'. Fill most of the frame.

images.description: A cluttered shop front with many boards, text in several sizes and colours, and no clear main message.
images.shotNotes: Choose one where it's genuinely hard to tell what the shop sells at a glance. Avoid people's faces.

images.description: A bus route/destination board, ideally with both Kannada and English.
images.shotNotes: Board readable in the photo. Avoid faces and number plates.

images.description: A toilet sign using male/female pictograms.
images.shotNotes: Straight-on photo of the sign only.

images.description: A road sign pointing towards a hospital (blue rectangle with 'H' or a hospital symbol).
images.shotNotes: Sign fills a good part of the frame.

images.description: A hand holding a hammer or a heavy mug with all fingers wrapped around the handle (power grip).
images.shotNotes: Side view, plain background, only the hand and object.

images.description: A hand holding a pen or needle between thumb and fingertips (precision grip).
images.shotNotes: Side view, plain background, only the hand and object.

images.description: A hand pointing its index finger STRAIGHT AT the camera (strong foreshortening).
images.shotNotes: Fingertip about 20 cm from the lens. The finger should look short and the fingertip large.

images.description: An older person climbing the high step into a bus, photographed from behind.
images.shotNotes: Ask permission. No face visible. The height of the first step should be obvious. A family member can pose for this.

images.description: A person carrying a load on their head or shoulder (vegetables, water pot, cylinder), from behind or the side.
images.shotNotes: Ask permission. No face visible. The posture (bent back, raised arm) should be clear.

images.description: A footpath BLOCKED by an obstruction (electric pole, parked two-wheeler or shop goods), with a HIGH kerb and NO ramp down to the road.
images.shotNotes: Both problems must be clearly visible: the obstruction and the high kerb step. No number plates or faces in focus.

images.description: A narrow residential lane with parked two-wheelers and overhead wires.
images.shotNotes: Shoot down the lane at eye level. No faces or number plates in focus.

images.description: A vegetable or flower market with rows of stalls.
images.shotNotes: Wide view with rows of repeated baskets/heaps. Avoid faces in focus.

images.description: A grey moulded-pulp egg tray, with or without eggs.
images.shotNotes: Three-quarter view so the cups and their shape are clear.

images.description: Food wrapped in a banana leaf, or an areca-leaf plate.
images.shotNotes: Plain background; show the fold or the pressed edge clearly.

images.description: A juice or milk carton (Tetra Pak-type) showing its folded top or end.
images.shotNotes: Turn the brand away from the camera if you can. Show the sealed fold.

images.description: A door that has a PULL-style handle on a side where you must actually PUSH.
images.shotNotes: If possible, include a handwritten 'PUSH' sign stuck on it. Shoot the handle and any sign together.

images.description: A switchboard with a row of 5+ identical, unlabelled switches.
images.shotNotes: Straight-on view. The switches should look the same, with no labels.

images.description: A flight of steps with no handrail.
images.shotNotes: Shoot from the bottom of the stairs so the missing rail is obvious.

images.description: A single subject (tree, lamp-post, person from behind) placed on the LEFT third, with the horizon on the LOWER third.
images.shotNotes: Turn on the phone's camera grid and line the subject up with the left grid line and the horizon with the bottom grid line.

images.description: A symmetrical, centred view of a temple gopura, gate or building entrance.
images.shotNotes: Stand exactly in the middle so the left and right halves mirror each other.

images.description: Repeated similar objects in rows (stacked steel plates, rows of pots, piles of coconuts).
images.shotNotes: Fill the frame with the repeated items. No single item should stand out.

images.description: One small subject (a kite, a bird, a lone tree) in a large empty area of sky or wall.
images.shotNotes: The subject should take up less than 10% of the frame.

images.description: Marigold garlands or heaps in yellow and orange only.
images.shotNotes: Fill the frame with yellow and orange flowers. Keep green leaves and other colours to a minimum.

images.description: Red tomatoes next to green chillies.
images.shotNotes: Roughly equal amounts of red and green, on a neutral background.
